subject.title: [Bug]: Slack channel history window is never cleared on reply; "Chat history since last reply" grows into a rolling buffer

question: Should always-on Slack room history clear after a confirmed visible reply, or should it remain a rolling context window with corrected labeling/watermark semantics?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally preserve rolling history for `requireMention: false`, while the prompt label and reporter expectation are reply-bounded; changing this affects existing always-on room behavior.

options.title: Clear after visible reply
options.body: Clear Slack always-on room history only when a visible reply is successfully delivered, keeping quiet room-event/no-reply context available until a real reply boundary.

options.title: Keep rolling and relabel
options.body: Preserve the current rolling processed-message behavior but change prompt/docs wording so it no longer claims to be strictly since the last reply.

options.title: Use self-watermark semantics
options.body: Record Slack outbound self entries and select history after the last self entry, closer to Telegram’s current rolling-window design but with a larger implementation surface.

recommendation.title: Clear after visible reply
recommendation.body: Clear Slack always-on room history only when a visible reply is successfully delivered, keeping quiet room-event/no-reply context available until a real reply boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The current code/docs blame points most directly to Peter Steinberger for the relevant Slack and shared channel-turn behavior.
